name: basecamp
description: Connect Basecamp to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Basecamp MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Basecamp to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with projects, to-dos, and messages using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Basecamp workspace.
Find anything in Basecamp that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review projects, to-dos, and messages in Basecamp.
